notes.title: Small Update - Achievements
notes.content: We would like to thank the user NovaScotiaSean for informing us about an important detail related to achievements. Thanks to his notification, we were able to identify and fix the issue. The update has been applied, and everything is now working correctly. We greatly appreciate his collaboration!

tags.bug: The update has been applied, and everything is now working correctly.

notes.title: Small Update |
notes.content: We've made a small update to Vida! Some text elements now have colors to better highlight marked or enabled options, preventing confusion. We've also made small fixes to the credits and other general improvements.
